run_single_gpu_test: run a single GPU test on a 3D detection model using a config file and checkpoint
run_multi_gpu_test: run a multi-GPU distributed test on a 3D detection model with pytorch or slurm launcher
evaluate_detection_metrics: evaluate a 3D detection model on metrics like bbox, segm, or mAP using the test script
fuse_conv_bn_for_inference: fuse convolution and batch normalization layers in a detection model to increase inference speed
format_and_save_results: format test output results to a pickle file and optionally show or submit them to a test server
